cohort_ledger.individualization_policy: No current separate personal-force manpower; Wei commands House-assigned formations without transferring House ownership.

representation.principle: Wei's personal troops remain conserved aggregate cohorts at scale; named, exceptional, command, specialist, socially relevant, or otherwise causally important people may materialize from those same bodies without increasing headcount.

geographic_disposition.rule: private force remains separate exact owner; home/deployment does not transfer ownership
